The exact failed production accessibility prompt and the consent/recovery boundary are locked by focused tests.

The corrected production replay preserves four named lessons, admits 4/4 source ledgers, compiles 9/9 material families, reports zero blockers or warnings, and its physical ZIP passes 38/38 export checks and offline regrading.

The CurriculumOS headless proof carries linked evidence through compilation and export: 8/8 astronomy lessons, eight citations, seven source resources, 9/9 deliverable families, 69 physical files, and 99/A conformance.
Scion remains the sole public identity and the observed adapter-less evidence/compiler route uses no model download, inference, or tokens.

The production audit covers every public deliverable, the source-bound Agent, responsive and color-mode frames, a clean console, and the physical ZIP; its generation-only timing defect is corrected so readiness ends after export verification and grading.
The release changes orchestration, parsing, and regression proof without changing Gemma weights or activating the optional adapter.
